title: Delivery Receipt Log Form
subtitle: Carrier Delivery Receipt: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Delivery Receipt Log Form covers transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record. The delivery operations coordinator records Carrier Delivery Receipt events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Delivery Receipt Log Form keeps Carrier Delivery Receipt exceptions visible until the delivery operations coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Delivery Receipt Log Form at vehicle, consignee dock, delivery point, and return documentation route. Document transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record identity before Carrier Delivery Receipt begins. Compare transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record findings with stated Carrier Delivery Receipt criteria; route unresolved Carrier Delivery Receipt issues to carrier documentation reviewer.

sections.title: Tracking review and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Carrier Delivery Receipt, identify responsible parties, vehicle, consignee dock, delivery point, and return documentation route, and the linked transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record source.

fields.label: Carrier, driver, vehicle, trailer, and seal
Piece, pallet, package, and consignee references

sections.title: Tracking review and variance evidence
sections.guidance: Capture Carrier Delivery Receipt facts for transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: Reconcile the latest Carrier Delivery Receipt event before closeout. Delivery Operations Coordinator identifies overdue action, the responsible party, and the event that reopens review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Count, seal, or freight condition exception
blocks.guidance: Pause Carrier Delivery Receipt when count, condition, recipient authority, exception notation, or document custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Carrier Delivery Receipt proof and route unresolved transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record scope to delivery operations coordinator.
